name: pair-bridge
description: Use local models through PAIR with versioned benchmarks, bounded loading, installed-only model management, structured output and concurrent jobs.

interface.shortDescription: Benchmark and consult local models through PAIR.
interface.longDescription: Run nested local model benchmarks, query durable quality/speed/error metrics and compare models; inspect capabilities, validate structured output and start concurrent jobs.
defaultPrompt: Use pair_devices and pair_list to inspect installed local models.
Use pair_smart_ask for a bounded task with an installed model.
Use pair_capabilities, then start pair_job_start on different PCs before polling pair_job_status.
